gloss: to be ahead of; to lead the way; to pioneer

definitions.gloss: to be ahead of; to lead the way; to come before
definitions.explanation: To do something before others do, or before an event. Mostly used in the set form 〜に{先駆|さきが}けて (ahead of …, before …).

examples.japanese: ⟦{他社|たしゃ}→他社：17803_tasha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先駆|さきが}けて
⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先駆|さきが}けて⟦{条例|じょうれい}→条例：08255_jourei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: They enacted the ordinance before anywhere else in the country.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先駆|さきが}けて、⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new release goes on sale to members only, ahead of the general release.

notes:
Almost always appears as 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先駆|さきが}けて or 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先駆|さきが}けた, typical of news and business writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先駆|さきが}けて: ahead of the rest of the world
- ⟦{他社|たしゃ}→他社：17803_tasha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先駆|さきが}けて: ahead of competitors
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先駆|さきが}けて: before the release

FORMS:
- ⟦{先駆|さきが}け→先駆け：23790_sakigake⟧: forerunner, pioneer; harbinger (⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先駆|さきが}け→先駆け：23790_sakigake⟧)
- ⟦{先駆者|せんくしゃ}→先駆者：27682_senkusha⟧: pioneer (person)
